purpose: Assesses a QR payment scheme's pilot, production, or cross-border go-live readiness through weighted blocking and advisory gates: participant certification, UAT completion, configuration sign-off, operating procedures, incident and support cover, communications, and cross-border link agreements, plus a Level One principles checklist (advisory only, separate from the verdict). Any blocking gate not met is NO_GO; a uat_summary with an open severity-1 defect or passed below mandatory_cases fails the UAT gate; otherwise the weighted basis-point score sets GO at or above 9750 or GO_WITH_CONDITIONS with the unmet advisory gates listed as conditions. Weight overrides must stay within 0 to 5000 bp and sum to 10000 bp across applicable gates, and are refused otherwise. Synthetic inputs only; the node names no real participant or scheme operator's readiness state and is a decision-support draft, not a supervisory assessment.
